name: Restoring the Necklace
label: Quest
description: Restoring the Necklace: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I gladly give you this necklace, mighty adventurer. You have done me an invaluable service, and for that I thank you. Wear it with pride, and make sure you mention loudly and repeatedly who made it for you!
Also, if you could toss in the fact that it really isn't cursed, that would be great.
